bull_case: Nu can compound through Brazil wallet-share expansion, Mexico/Colombia scaling and broader lending/investment/SME products. The locked Bull value is about $34.85/share, roughly 2.48x the frozen price.
bear_case: The locked Bear value is only about 34% of price. A credit-cycle shock, weaker underwriting or heavier capital retention could compress distributable earnings materially even if the franchise remains solvent.
thesis: NU offers strong but not exceptional large-cap asymmetry. Bull/current is about 2.48x with several independent growth paths, supporting a 75 upside score. Bear/current is about 0.34x, mapping to a 55 permanent-loss score under the observable anchor. The bank remains well capitalized, so business-extinction risk is low, but equity-value dispersion remains wide because credit losses and capital retention can materially change distributable earnings.

evidence.claim: Locked values are about $4.76 Bear, $18.56 Base and $34.85 Bull versus $14.03 current price; Bull/current is about 2.48x and Bear/current about 0.34x.
Nu reached almost 118M customers in Brazil with activity above 86%, leaving further monetization through primary-bank status, upmarket products and SMEs.
Mexico and Colombia together exceeded 20M customers by Q2 2026, providing a second growth path outside mature Brazil.
The credit portfolio reached $39.4B, up 37% YoY, creating a third monetization path but also increasing loss and capital sensitivity.
Brazil CET1 was 11.9% and CAR 15.7%, with $1.848B of excess capital margin; Mexico and Colombia capital ratios were 14.9% and 15.3%, all above local minimums.

counterevidence: A regulated bank cannot distribute all reported earnings because high growth consumes equity capital.
90+ NPL increased to 6.9% in Q2 as the portfolio expanded into higher-risk segments.
Brazil remains the dominant earnings exposure, so country, rate and FX shocks are correlated rather than independent.
The Bull case requires sustained high ROE while scaling international operations and credit simultaneously.
unknowns: Matched base rates for 2.5x-5x outcomes from financial firms starting near a $70B market capitalization.
Long-run capital payout capacity once Brazil growth moderates and Mexico becomes a full bank.
Normalized credit losses as newer risk cohorts season.
falsifiers: ROE falls structurally below the mid-20s while credit growth remains capital intensive.
90+ NPL and ECL rise enough to break the Base distributable-earnings path.
Mexico and Colombia fail to converge toward profitable primary-bank economics.

hard_veto_flags.veto: 현재가격이 비현실적인 Bull Case 이상을 요구
hard_veto_flags.rationale: The frozen price is far below the locked Bull value, so a Bull-plus outcome is not required.

hard_veto_flags.veto: 파산 또는 영구손실 확률이 기대수익에 비해 지나치게 높음
hard_veto_flags.rationale: Local regulated subsidiaries remain above capital minima with meaningful excess capital and diversified retail deposits. Valuation downside is substantial but does not establish a high probability of franchise extinction.

key_kpis.name: ROE / capital retention
key_kpis.threshold: high-20s+ ROE without consuming excess capital excessively

key_kpis.name: 90+ NPL / ECL
key_kpis.threshold: credit loss trends remain consistent with Base distributable earnings

next_checks: Re-run asymmetry after Q3 2026 NPL, ROE and capital ratios.
Build a financial-sector large-cap multi-bagger base-rate set.
Estimate distributable earnings under explicit capital-ratio targets.

subscores.rationale: Bull/current is about 2.48x and there are at least three independent economic paths: Brazil wallet-share, international scaling, and broader credit/financial-product monetization. This maps to the 1.6-2.5x / 2+ paths observable row.
Bear/current is about 0.34x. Band-centre interpolation of the 0.2-0.4 row rounds to 55. The net-cash modifier does not apply to the bank-specific valuation convention.
Scenario sensitivity is explicit, but no matched bank/fintech historical base-rate dataset is frozen. This is stronger than narrative-only calibration and below the 75 base-rate anchor.

uncertainties.rationale: Large absolute scale raises the hurdle for 3x+ equity outcomes.
Credit losses and capital retention can create large permanent equity-value impairment without insolvency.
Scenario probabilities remain judgmental without matched historical base rates.
